items.scope: Dugite native v2.53.0-4: Git, Git LFS, Git Credential Manager and platform libraries/tools
items.action: Implemented: every release target now ships a corresponding-source archive built in CI (scripts/release/native-source.cjs, policy third_party/native-source.json) holding the pinned upstream sources of the exact bundled Git, Git LFS and Git Credential Manager (all platforms) plus, for Windows, the Git for Windows fork and the MSYS2/MinGW package sources, build-extra and OpenSSL. The archive is staged, checksummed, attested and required by the publication gate. Disclosed deviations: bash uses the MSYS2 5.2.037-2 source package (the -1 source is no longer hosted); OpenSSL 3.5.5 comes from the upstream tarball plus the Git for Windows packaging commits; MinGit's package-versions.txt is stale versus git.exe 2.53.0.windows.4. Remaining step: after the final release commit, run the release matrix, review the archives, then record the reviewer, date and per-target input hashes and mark this item cleared.

items.scope: Native Codex and TypeScript-Go embedded dependencies
items.action: Per-platform findings are recorded for macOS, Linux and Windows x64 (third_party/evidence/native-ai-platform-packages.json, from the published npm tarballs, not run on those platforms). TypeScript native 7.0.2: NOTICE.txt and LICENSE are in every platform package and byte-identical. Codex 0.162.1: every platform package also ships an optional voice runtime (LGPL-2.1 GStreamer/GLib, Opus, libffi, PCRE2, and Microsoft vcruntime140.dll on Windows) that FDO does not use; it is excluded from the app by webpack.main.config.js and enforced by third_party/distribution-policy.json (codex-voice-runtime), and the Codex CLI was confirmed to run without it. Linux ships a bubblewrap helper (LGPL-2.0-or-later) whose vendored source is added to the Linux native-source archive (openai/codex at commit 092d3acd). Still open: Codex helper binaries (rg, zsh, Windows sandbox executables) and Rust crates rely on the upstream NOTICE and the source-lock inventory; no complete native SBOM exists. After the final release commit, review the packaged builds, then record the reviewer, date and per-target input hashes.
